cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Neither of us has been emotionally changed by the biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't need chess to change me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll enjoy discovering how much the kitchen matters.

mechanism: A bargains a biscuit chess game up to weekend cooking, makes adjacent concessions and insists on a consequence that changes the next days.
confusable: Unlike choosing a novel prize, A increases the risk so this game settles a meaningful obligation.
comparison: Weekend kitchen labor with dish support differs from a captaincy rematch with a reduced duration.
seedUse: D200-a biscuit and weekend cooking; S02-a offers dish work and menu control to secure the bigger bet.
